loader_equivalence_check.what: the real per-label adapter reproduces the shipped map_spots on the shipped SYNTHETIC snaps

dime_dl5_seat_hours_pooled.note: seat-hours = leftover snaps (snap_counts) beyond the named seats, per play; can exceed 1.0 with rotations — the rotation measure, not a seat-occupancy share. The real per-play occupancy comparators are the dl5_play_share / dpkg_share.dime fields.

rows.basis: per-play share of >=5-DL packages (mapping-limited: the engine's DL5 is a DT2-substitution seat; see report)

regime_labels.2025: DK permanent + TB 35 + reg-season OT both-possess

DL5: DL snaps beyond the four LineOf slots (the rotation seat)
DIME: DB snaps beyond the six base/nickel DB seats (the 6th DB)

real_adaptation.combo_labels: first token of X/Y is primary
real_adaptation.note: seats mirror the shipped GROUP_SEATS per specific label; only the genuinely generic real labels are routed (generic OL->OL_EXTRA, DL->DL5, DB->DIME; S covers the SS/FS pair, which the Ledger stages at 1.0/1.0); the adapter is equivalence-checked against the shipped mapper on the synthetic files
